summary_1line: Vyasa describes the cosmic dissolution where elements collapse into subtler principles until all merges into Brahman and the cycle of creation resumes.

image_candidates.scene_text: A dozen blazing suns and roaring cosmic fire engulf the universe as planets, mountains, and creatures dissolve into flame.
The earth stripped bare of trees and life lies smooth and empty like a tortoise shell before being swallowed by surging cosmic waters.
Vast elements collapse one into another—fire into wind, wind into space—until the universe fades into a silent, unmanifest void.
